description: Microsoft is a technology company committed to making digital technology and artificial intelligence available broadly and doing so responsibly, with a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. It develops and supports a broad portfolio of technology solutions for individuals and businesses, focusing on secure, trusted and innovative platforms and applications that meet evolving customer needs across AI, cloud computing, productivity and collaboration, and personal computing, and it strives to create opportunity, growth and impact in every country around the world. AI is fundamentally transforming productivity for every individual, organization and industry, and Microsoft's AI offerings span every layer of the technology stack, enabling transformative outcomes across sectors and unlocking opportunity for every country, community and individual, with the company believing AI should be as empowering as it is powerful and committing to designing and deploying AI responsibly.
